title: Best Air Purifier Under ₹15,000 in India (2026): Real HEPA Picks That Cut PM2.5
description: Compare the best air purifiers under ₹15,000 in India by CADR, HEPA grade, room coverage and filter cost, ranked for Indian bedrooms and small halls.
short_desc: Five HEPA air purifiers for Indian bedrooms and small halls, ranked by clean-air delivery and ownership cost.

headings.text: What actually matters in an air purifier under ₹15,000

cta.headline: Filter cost over 3 years matters more than sticker price
cta.sub: An ₹8,000 purifier with ₹3,500/year filters can cost more than a ₹14,000 purifier with ₹2,000/year filters. Add up the totals before you click buy.

faq.q: What room size does an air purifier under ₹15,000 cover?
faq.a: Most models in this range cover 200-400 sq ft. Match the CADR to your room: a 250 sq ft bedroom needs at least 180 m³/h CADR for one clean-air pass in 12 minutes.

faq.q: How often do HEPA filters need changing on budget purifiers?
faq.a: Every 6-12 months depending on AQI exposure and usage hours. Budget filters cost ₹1,500-₹3,500 per set. Factor this into your total cost of ownership before buying.

faq.q: Do air purifiers under ₹15,000 really work for PM2.5?
faq.a: Yes, if they have a true HEPA H13 or H14 filter (not marketing-grade HEPA-type). Verified models from Sharp, Dyson, Philips and Xiaomi drop indoor PM2.5 from 250 to under 30 in 15-20 minutes in a closed 200 sq ft room.

faq.q: Is an ionizer or UV purifier worth buying?
faq.a: Ionizers alone don't remove PM2.5 effectively. UV-C adds a sterilization layer but the budget class usually drops it. Stick with mechanical HEPA + activated carbon for particulate and odor removal.

faq.q: Can I run an air purifier all day on my electricity bill?
faq.a: Yes. Budget purifiers draw 25-55W. Running 12 hours a day costs roughly ₹30-₹60/month at ₹8/unit. Compare the wattage before you pick — a 25W model pays for its premium in 2 years.

tldr_pick: Our top pick is the Sharp FP-J30 at ₹12,499 — it pairs genuine H13 HEPA with a 230 m³/h CADR that handles a 240 sq ft bedroom in one 12-minute clean-air pass. For budget buyers, the Xiaomi Smart Air Purifier 4 at ₹11,999 is the value pick thanks to its ₹1,499/year filter cost.
key_takeaways: True H13 HEPA captures 99.95% of PM2.5 — avoid HEPA-type marketing-grade filters.
Match CADR to room size: at least 180 m³/h for a 200 sq ft bedroom, 250+ for halls.
Filter cost over 3 years is the real cost — budget ₹1,500-₹3,500/year per set.
Avoid ionizer-only purifiers: they don't actually remove PM2.5 and produce ozone.
who_for: Anyone in a Delhi NCR, Kanpur, Lucknow or any AQI-200+ city looking for a HEPA purifier for a 200-300 sq ft bedroom or small hall under ₹15,000.
methodology: We compared air purifiers available on Amazon India and Flipkart under ₹15,000. For each model we verified HEPA grade (H13/H14 vs HEPA-type), measured CADR against room coverage claims, calculated 3-year filter cost, and confirmed service network reach across metro and tier-2 cities.
